description: Effects of Margretta Stewart Dietrich: 1. Obituary. 2. Booklet: "New Mexico Recollections, part II," by Margretta Dietrich [2 copies]. 3. Memorial book for Alice Brock by Margretta Dietrich. 4. Print out [4 pp.] of an online search regarding Margretta Dietrich. 5. Carbon copy of notice of filing a will of Margretta Dietrich, Jan. 20, 1961. 6. Letter concerning Dietrich's will from John T. Watkins to Maria Chabot, Feb. 1, 1961.
title: Margretta Dietrich will and effects
